title: Skull Cap Stripe TC-1

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: The Daytona Skull Cap Stripe TC-1 delivers stripped-down minimalist coverage for relaxed warm-weather cruising, pairing low-profile styling with essential certified head protection. Built around a High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell weighing 1417g, its multi-density EPS matrix is aerodynamically sculpted to isolate cabin noise to ~102 dB while dissipating kinetic impact forces across DOT, ECE 22.05 benchmarks. The interior features a plush, moisture-wicking crown liner shaped for Intermediate Oval head shapes, secured by track-proven Double D-Ring retention for effortless warm-weather riding.

product_details.description: Ultra-slim DOT half helmet — one of the smallest profiles available.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Designed for aggressive riding posture; cheek pads may require adjustment for high-profile chin guards.

technical_analysis: Features Advanced multi-composite aerodynamic shell geometry engineered for optimal impact absorption and stability paired with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release. The interior utilizes Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the Daytona Skull Cap Stripe TC-1: combining Global Certified craftsmanship with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release and Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.

introduction: Positioned in Daytona's Half lineup, the Skull Cap Stripe TC-1 brings Global Premium engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, ECE 22.05 track safety.
story:
The Daytona Skull Cap Stripe TC-1 represents Daytona's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~102 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking a High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan Half helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the Daytona Skull Cap Stripe TC-1 delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
